subject: TLS ABI landed in n2r; two small wiring edits needed
body:
n2r side is implemented/tested (12 PASS release+ASan). Exact current header: n2r_draw_options now has thread_storage_bytes + thread_storage_reserved after base_instance; n2r_addresses has tls after no_secondary. Please wire:
RENDER (compositor_submit.inc:285): initializer must add two zeros, and force v3 when TLS is nonzero. Dispatch needs a TLS byte field sourced from max(vs->tls,fs->tls) of the selected compiled pipeline/variant; current pipeline structs already carry vertexCode.tls/fragmentCode.tls (render_pipeline.inc:734/1718). Example: struct n2r_draw_options options={N2R_DRAW_OPTIONS_VERSION,j->genericDrawFlags,j->genericVertexBase,j->genericBaseInstance,j->genericThreadStorage,0}; and if(j->genericDrawFlags||v2need||j->genericThreadStorage).
COMPUTE (bridge draw_locked): when opts&&opts->thread_storage_bytes, allocate per=next_pow2(align16(bytes)), total=per*2048*cores using the existing core-range helper, 4096-aligned; set a.tls; add the BO handle to submit refs with write=0; release in cleanup/after wait. If absent/failed return BAD before n2r_build; n2r_build rejects bytes>0 with zero/unaligned a.tls. Zero bytes must leave a.tls unused; LOAD preload copies a and then calls n2r_build with pa.tls nonzero (TLS bytes0) - n2r deliberately ignores tls in that case, so do not zero it on my account. If you prefer, zeroing pa.tls is also fine.
No other n2r signature changed. Please ACK field names or send an alternative; n2r cannot allocate/retain BOs itself.
